data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Terrible customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a398d8d000a13e6c2c2ab61)
Following up on a delivery, at first I was told by L & G my delivery would NOT come last week. A delivery company was telling me they WERE delivering a rug - but a different rug - and from Quince. Only Quince was able to answer queries in real time. Your chatbot was not even available at times when it should have been. Email answers from you took 48 hours and were NOT clear. Delivery company delivered the rug on schedule, but it was mislabeled so we had to unpack it to check it was the right product. This was terrible communication and technology from everyone but Quince. You should provide a phone number for time-sensitive questions. This was my worst customer service experience in a long time.

June 19, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 23, 2026

Hello,

Thank you for your feedback! We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. We understand you were in contact with our Customer support team, and they addressed the miscommunication regarding the rug tracking information. Our Customer support team is available during regular business hours via email, live chat, and phone. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and are happy to assist you.

Lulu and Georgia
